title: Annihilation/Quotes
kind: 場所・ミッション・その他

lines: - Teshin: "Oro is the binding force for an enemy who, like the Tenno, can survive death. To kill such an enemy is futile, unless you sever this bond; absorb the Oro to annihilate it and claim a true victory."
- Teshin: "Tenno, you are in the lead."
- Teshin: "You are at the head of the pack."
- Teshin: "An adversary has overtaken the lead."
- Teshin: "The lead has been taken by another Tenno."
- Teshin: "Another Tenno has claimed more Oro."
- Teshin: "With five more Oro, you will take victory."
- Teshin: "Annihilate five more Oro to win the match."
- Teshin: "The Oro of five more fallen stands between you and victory."
- Teshin: "The leader is just five Oro away from winning."
- Teshin: "Only five Oro stands between an adversary and victory."
- Teshin: "An opponent needs to annihilate five more Oro to seal the match."
- Teshin: "You have seized the win Tenno."
- Teshin: "Victory is yours, may the lessons you have learned here serve you well in battle."
- Teshin: "Dedication and training have led you down the path to victory."
- Teshin: "The match is yours but be mindful about feeding your ego this victory."
- Teshin: "Even in victory you must ask yourself: are you truly ready for what lies ahead?"
- Teshin: "This loss has illuminated your weakness Tenno. Practice will be your way."
- Teshin: "Match over. Meditate on this loss."
- Teshin: "You have lost this match. Will you allow this to happen again?"
- Teshin: "Match over. In this loss know that the Conclave is a grindstone forever sharpening the Tenno."
- Teshin: "The match has ended. Even in defeat your readiness grows."
